Aria: Quick flag: onboarding a Llama->Gemma converted model (int8) and seeing reproducible token drift after ~15 tokens across machines. Probable qkv packing or rotary axis swap. Anyone?

Dev: First check tokenizer ids across hosts (tiny mismatch once caused drift for us). Then dump qkv shapes and rotary table dims.

henry: Also check whether converter wrote rotary freqs as (seq_len, head_dim) vs runtime expecting (head_dim, seq_len). Axis swap will slowly desync phase.

Aria: Tokenizer ids matched. qkv weight shape: (3072, 1024). Rotary freqs: (64, 128) on host A but (128, 64) on host B 1: that was it.

Dev: Fix: transpose rotary table on load when dims mismatch and add assertion in onboarding test.

Aria: Patched loader, now stable to 512 tokens. Opening PR with loader fix and a small unit test (seeded generation equality).

ci-bot: created PR #1317 by Aria 1: add-rotary-dim-check (checks: unit-tests running)
